text_1981: Such is the creation of God; show me what their idols have created. Indeed, the wicked are totally astray.
text_1989: Such is the creation of GOD; show me what any idols besides Him have created. Indeed, the transgressors are far astray.
text_ref: Such is the creation of GOD; show me what the idols you set up beside Him have created. Indeed, the transgressors are far astray.

subtitle: Luqmãn's Wisdom
text_1981: We have endowed Luqmãn with wisdom: "You shall be appreciative of GOD." Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good. As for those who turn unappreciative, GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy.
text_1989: We have endowed Luqmaan with wisdom: “You shall be appreciative of GOD.’ but if one turns unappreciative, then GOD is in no need, Most Praised.
text_ref: We have endowed Luqmãn with wisdom: "You shall be appreciative of GOD." Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good. As for those who turn unappreciative, GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy.

text_1981: Recall that Luqmãn said to his son, as he enlightened him, "O my son, do not set up any idols beside GOD; idolatry is a gross injustice."*
footnote_1981: *31:13 How will you feel if you take care of a child, give him the best education, and prepare him for life, only to see him thank someone else? Thus is idolatry; injustice.

text_1981: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. His mother bore him, and the load got heavier and heavier. It takes two years (of intensive care) until weaning. You shall be appreciative of Me, and of your parents. To Me is the ultimate destiny.

text_1981: If they try to force you to set up any idols beside Me, do not obey them. But continue to treat them amicably in this world. You shall follow only the path of those who have submitted to Me. Ultimately, you all return to Me, then I will inform you of everything you have done.

subtitle: Luqmãn's Advice
text_1981: "O my son, know that even something as tiny as a mustard seed, deep inside a rock, be it in the heavens or the earth, GOD will bring it. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.
text_1989: “O my son, know that even some­ thing as tiny as a mustard seed, deep inside a rock, be it in the heavens or the earth, GOD will bring it. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.
text_ref: "O my son, know that even something as tiny as a mustard seed, deep inside a rock, be it in the heavens or the earth, GOD will bring it. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.

text_1981: "O my son, you shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat). You shall advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and remain steadfast in the face of adversity. These are the most honorable traits.
text_1989: “O my son, you shall observe the contact prayers (Salat), enjoin righteousness and forbid evil, and remain steadfast in the face of adversity. These are the most honorable traits.
text_ref: "O my son, you shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat). You shall advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and remain steadfast in the face of adversity. These are the most honorable traits.

text_1981: "You shall not treat the people with arrogance, nor shall you roam the earth proudly. GOD does not like the arrogant showoffs.
text_1989: “You shall not treat the people with arrogance, nor shall you walk on earth proudly. GOD does not like the arrogant showoffs.
text_ref: "You shall not treat the people with arrogance, nor shall you roam the earth proudly. GOD does not like the arrogant showoffs.

text_1981: "Walk humbly and lower your voice—the ugliest voice is the donkey's voice."
text_1989: “Walk humbly and lower your voice—the ugliest voice is the donkey’s voice.”
text_ref: "Walk humbly and lower your voice—the ugliest voice is the donkey's voice."

text_1981: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth, and has showered you with His blessings— obvious and hidden? Yet, some people argue about GOD without knowledge, without guidance, and without the enlightening scripture.
text_1989: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth, and has showered you with His blessings—obvious and hidden? without knowledge, without guidance, and without (knowing) the enlightening scripture.
text_ref: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth, and has showered you with His blessings— obvious and hidden? Yet, some people argue about GOD without knowledge, without guidance, and without the enlightening scripture.

subtitle: Following the Parents Blindly: A Common Tragedy
text_1981: When they are told, "Follow these revelations of GOD," they say, "No, we follow only what we found our parents doing." What if the devil is leading them to the agony of Hell?

subtitle: They Believe in God
text_1981: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth," they will say, "GOD." Say, "Praise be to GOD." Yet, most of them do not know.

text_1989: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is the Most Rich, Most Praised.
text_ref: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is the Most Rich, Most Praiseworthy.

subtitle: These Are All the Words We Need
text_1981: If all the trees on earth were made into pens, and the ocean supplied the ink, augmented by seven more oceans, the words of GOD would not run out. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
text_1989: If all the trees on earth were made into pens, and the ocean supplied the ink, augmented by seven more oceans, the words of GOD would not run out. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

text_ref: The creation and resurrection of all of you is the same as that of one person. GOD is Hearer, Seer.

subtitle: God ALONE Worthy of Worship
text_1981: Do you not realize that GOD merges the night into the day and merges the day into the night, and that He has committed the sun and the moon in your service, each running in its orbit for a specific life span, and that GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do?
text_1989: Do you not realize that GOD merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night? And that He has committed the sun and the moon; each running in its orbit for a specific life span? And that GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do?

text_1981: This proves that GOD is the truth, while any idol they set up beside Him is falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, Most Great.
text_1989: This proves that GOD is the truth, that any idol they set up besides Him is falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, Most Great.

text_1989: When violent waves surround them, they implore GOD, sincerely devoting the religion to Him alone. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, some of them revert. except the betrayer, unappreciative.
text_ref: When violent waves surround them, they implore GOD, sincerely devoting their prayers to Him alone. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, some of them revert. None discards our revelations except those who are betrayers, unappreciative.

subtitle: Things We May and May Not Know*
text_1981: With GOD is the knowledge regarding the Hour (end of the world).* He is the One who sends down the rain, and He knows the contents of the womb. No soul knows what will happen to it tomorrow, and no one knows in which land he or she will die. GOD is Omniscient, Cognizant.
footnote_1981: *31:34 God reveals His knowledge whenever He wills. We learn from this verse that we may be able to predict the rain, and the gender of the fetus. But we can never know the time or place of death. In accordance with 72:27, God has revealed the end of the world through His Messenger of the Covenant. See 15:87, 20:15, and Appendix 25 for the details.
